description_and_purpose.text: Welcome To Punch and Steal an Egg 🥊 👊 Punch eggs open to hatch rare animals 🏃 Grab them and run before the angry Mother catches you! 🌱 Put animals in your garden to earn cash 😈 Steal animals from other players' gardens 🏋️ Bench press to get stronger and carry heavier animals 👟 Run on treadmills to get faster and unlock new zones 🧤 Unlock stronger gloves and cool trails 🌍 Explore new zones! 📖 Collect every animal in the Index! ❤️ Like & favorite for updates!
